name: Alik Lorenz
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: A light heavyweight prospect (8-2; UFC debut; about 6-foot-2 with a 77.5-inch reach) who won a contract on his second try on the Contender Series, knocking out Mahamed Aly at 2:23 of R1 in August. Nearly every fight he has had ended in R1, in either direction. Thin footage-based scouting available.

how_they_fight.Striking: Power puncher: seven of eight wins are R1 KO/TKOs. A big right hand dropped Aly before hammerfists ended it, and he stopped Gabriel Thimoteo in LFA in under 30 seconds with a right hook and ground-and-pound (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Grappling: One submission win (Ryan Parker, R3, LFA 2024). Little detail available on his wrestling.
how_they_fight.Defense: Both losses are fast knockouts: Darion Abbey at 0:33 of R1 (2021) and Abdul-Rakhman Yakhyaev at 0:30 of R1 on the 2025 Contender Series, where he landed 1 significant strike to 16 (our data). Cageside's write-up suggests he is vulnerable to fast, high-volume attackers.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Largely unknown. Nine of his ten fights ended in R1; the exception was the R3 submission of Parker at 4:46. He has never gone to a decision.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Finish-minded: said before the Aly fight it would 'definitely' end in a finish and he wouldn't let it go to the judges (Cageside).

patterns: R1 knockout puncher: seven R1 KO/TKOs
Both losses were R1 knockouts inside 35 seconds
concerns: Defense against a fast, accurate starter
keys_to_beat: Be careful early, test his chin and pace, and take him into R2-R3
Wrestle him; little is known about his ground defense
Lead with volume rather than trading single power shots

news.text: Booked to debut against Diyar Nurgozhay at UFC Qatar.
Won a UFC contract with a R1 KO of Mahamed Aly on the Contender Series.
